snippet.title: GO HOME ANNIE: AN SCP GAME  | New UPDATE & CONSOLES RELEASE TRAILER | Nordcurrent Labs
snippet.description:
We're happy to announce:

✨Our big Update for Go Home Annie: An SCP Game is OUT NOW!✨ Check it out on your platform and play today!

(* Xbox Series X|S release has been slightly delayed – sorry for the inconvenience.)
_________________________

Take on the role of Annie, a low-level employee of the SCP Foundation, a covert organization meant to secure and contain anomalous entities and protect the general public from them.

Why has an organization with the motto "Secure, Contain, Protect" created a division for replicating dangerous paranormal events and anomalous entities? Why are you tasked with repeatedly testing the same replicas, with a seemingly never-changing outcome? You will need to take drastic actions to uncover your true purpose and alter the course of your fate.
__________________________

Play on 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1939100/Go_Home_Annie_An_SCP_Game/  🖤
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/go_home_annie 🖤 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/go-home-annie-26ee8e 🖤 
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015151 🖤 
Xbox Series X|S:  TBA 🖤
